stages.name: Receive invoice
stages.detail: PDF validated and saved privately; 1 page(s).

stages.name: Extract invoice
stages.detail: OCR used on page(s) 1. Excerpts are OCR transcriptions; compare with the original PDF. Groq response validated; source excerpts checked against the extracted text.

stages.name: Validate information
stages.detail: 1 line items; 0 extraction warnings. Amounts use decimal arithmetic.

stages.name: Match purchase order
stages.detail: Loaded approved vendor register, purchase orders, and matching invoice history from Supabase.

stages.name: Save decision
stages.detail: Decision and rule evidence saved. No payment initiated.
